name: Slack
description: Slack integration for ActonOS AI agents with Block Kit formatting, multi-account routing, and thread replies
author: ActonOS

poll_interval_seconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Delay in seconds between Slack conversations.history polling cycles

accounts.title: Bot Accounts
accounts.description: Configure one or multiple Slack Bot integrations

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance used for routing and session isolation

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this Slack account

bot_token.title: Slack Bot User OAuth Token
bot_token.description: Bot token starting with xoxb- from Slack App Dashboard

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @mention is present

listen_target.title: Listen Channel ID
listen_target.description: Slack channel ID to poll (e.g. C0123456789)

enable_typing_indicator.title: Live Typing Indicator
enable_typing_indicator.description: Slack Web API has no public typing endpoint; outbound typing events are accepted as no-ops so the host contract stays uniform

enable_ack_reaction.title: Acknowledge with Reaction
enable_ack_reaction.description: React to the user's message via reactions.add to acknowledge receipt

enable_reply_quote.title: Quote / Thread Reply
enable_reply_quote.description: Attach outbound replies as a Slack thread (thread_ts)

ack_reaction_emoji.title: Acknowledgement Emoji
ack_reaction_emoji.description: Unicode emoji or Slack short name (👀 / eyes)
